<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><span id="sq_008"></span>ALLIANCE
ENTERTAINMENT HOLDING CORPORATION</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>NOTES
TO UNAUDITED CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt; background-color: white"><b>March
31</b></span><b><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">, 2026</span></b></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" escape="true" id="Fact000593" name="us-gaap:OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_805_eus-gaap--OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsDisclosureTextBlock_zI6K8N77FtZj" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
1: <span id="xdx_826_zLc892OuC6Af">Organization and Summary of Significant Accounting Policies</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Alliance
is a leading global wholesaler and distributor of physical media, entertainment products, hardware, and accessories across various platforms.
Employing an established multi-channel strategy, Alliance operates as the vital link between renowned international manufacturers of
entertainment content and top-tier retail partners both domestically and internationally. Additionally, Alliance manages a diverse portfolio
of owned e-commerce brands through its DirectToU LLC division, catering to various entertainment and collectible markets. Alliance also
provides state-of-the art warehousing and distribution technologies, operating systems and services that seamlessly enable entertainment
product transactions to better serve customers directly or through our distribution affiliates.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
December 31, 2025, the Company completed the acquisition of Endstate Authentic LLC (&#8220;LLC&#8221;), a digital authentication and
loyalty-driven consumer brand. The transaction was accounted for as a business combination under ASC 805. Accordingly, the assets acquired
and liabilities assumed have been recorded at their estimated fair values as of the acquisition date. The purchase price allocation is
preliminary and subject to adjustment as the Company continues to finalize its valuation analyses. Results of operations for Endstate
are included in the Company&#8217;s condensed consolidated financial statements beginning on the acquisition date. Additional information
related to this acquisition is provided in Note 23 &#8211; Business Combinations.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
February 10, 2023, Alliance completed its business combination with Adara Acquisition Corp., which was accounted for as a reverse recapitalization
with Alliance treated as the accounting acquirer (the &#8220;Merger&#8221;). The recapitalization has been retroactively reflected in
all periods presented. The Company continues to recognize certain warrant and equity-related impacts from this transaction, including
the outstanding Class E contingent shares and warrant liabilities, as discussed further in Notes 16 and 21.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
accompanying unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements contain all adjustments (consisting only of normal recurring accruals
and adjustments) which are necessary in order to state fairly the Company&#8217;s results of operations, financial position, stockholders&#8217;
equity and cash flows as of and for the periods presented. The results of operations for interim periods are not necessarily indicative
of the results to be expected for the full year or any other future period. The unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements
should be read in conjunction with the Company&#8217;s audited consolidated financial statements and related notes, including the Summary
of Significant Accounting Policies, included in the Company&#8217;s Annual Report on Form 10-K filed September 10, 2025. June 30, 2025,
balance sheet information contained herein was derived from the Company&#8217;s audited consolidated financial statements as of that
date included therein.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" escape="true" id="Fact000595" name="us-gaap:PriorPeriodReclassificationAdjustmentDescription"><p id="xdx_847_eus-gaap--PriorPeriodReclassificationAdjustmentDescription_zzsrGZY3TBtg" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Reclassification</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Certain
amounts from prior periods have been reclassified to conform to the current period presentation.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" escape="true" id="Fact000597" name="us-gaap:BasisOfAccountingPolicyPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_84A_eus-gaap--BasisOfAccountingPolicyPolicyTextBlock_z1nvTeO0SgO1" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Basis
for Presentation</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
condensed consolidated financial statements have been prepared on the accrual basis of accounting in accordance with accounting principles
generally accepted in the United States of America (U.S. GAAP). The condensed consolidated financial statements include the accounts
of Alliance Entertainment Holding Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries. Intercompany transactions have been eliminated in consolidation.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" escape="true" id="Fact000599" name="AENT:SubstantialDoubtAboutGoingConcernPolicyPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_84D_ecustom--SubstantialDoubtAboutGoingConcernPolicyPolicyTextBlock_zzfq05TgoZ3i" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Liquidity</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
October 1, 2025, the Company entered into a $<span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity_iI_pn6n6_c20251001__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__us-gaap--RevolvingCreditFacilityMember__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember_zsWeEDl2cSwc" title="Credit facility, maximum borrowing capacity"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" contextRef="AsOf2025-10-01_us-gaap_RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_custom_WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember" id="Fact000601" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">120</ix:nonFraction></span>
million senior secured asset-based revolving credit facility with Bank of America, N.A. (the &#8220;Revolving Credit
Facility&#8221;). The new facility refinanced and replaced the Company&#8217;s prior <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentTerm_dtY_c20231221__20231221__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__us-gaap--RevolvingCreditFacilityMember__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember_zm1XoTYMwkxj" title="Debt instrument, term" style="display: none"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2023-12-212023-12-21_us-gaap_RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_custom_WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="Fact000603" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentTerm">3</ix:nonNumeric></span> three-year $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity_iI_pn6n6_c20231221__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__us-gaap--RevolvingCreditFacilityMember__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember_z7nrXocXUAV4" title="Credit facility, maximum borrowing capacity"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" contextRef="AsOf2023-12-21_us-gaap_RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_custom_WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember" id="Fact000605" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">120</ix:nonFraction></span> million asset-based revolving

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" escape="true" id="Fact000677" name="us-gaap:NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock"><p id="xdx_847_eus-gaap--NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock_zCjoB0pRovId" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Accounting
Pronouncements</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Recently
Issued and Adopted Accounting Pronouncements</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
July 2025, the Company adopted Accounting Standards Update (&#8220;ASU&#8221;) 2024-02, Codification Improvements -Amendments to Remove
References to the Concepts Statements. This ASU removes references to the FASB Concepts Statements from the Accounting Standards Codification
and makes related conforming amendments. The adoption of ASU 2024-02 did not have a material impact on the Company&#8217;s condensed
consolidated financial statements or related disclosures.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
July 2025, the Company adopted ASU 2024-01, Compensation - Stock Compensation (Topic 718): Scope Application of Profits Interest and
Similar Awards, which clarifies how entities determine whether certain profits interest or similar awards should be accounted for as
stock-based compensation under Topic 718 or under other applicable guidance. The Company does not issue profits interest or similar awards,
and adoption of this ASU did not have a material impact on its condensed consolidated financial statements.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Recently
Issued but Not Yet Adopted Accounting Pronouncements</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>&#160;</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
November 2024, the Financial Accounting Standards Board (&#8220;FASB&#8221;) issued ASU 2024-03, Income Statement - Reporting Comprehensive
Income - Expense Disaggregation Disclosures (Subtopic 220-40), which requires additional disaggregation of certain income statement expense
categories in the notes to the financial statements. The ASU is effective for annual reporting periods beginning after December 15, 2026,
and interim reporting periods beginning after December 15, 2027, with early adoption permitted. The Company is currently evaluating the
impact of this ASU on its condensed consolidated financial statement disclosures.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
December 2023, the FASB issued ASU 2023-09, Improvements to Income Tax Disclosures, which enhances income tax disclosure requirements,
including expanded disaggregation of effective tax rate reconciliations and income taxes paid by jurisdiction. The standard is effective
for fiscal years beginning after December 15, 2024, with early adoption permitted. The Company is evaluating the impact of this ASU,
which is expected to primarily affect annual income tax disclosures.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
May 2025, the FASB issued ASU 2025-03, Business Combinations (Topic 805) and Consolidation (Topic 810): Determining the Accounting Acquirer
in the Acquisition of a Variable Interest Entity. The amendments are effective for fiscal years beginning after December 15, 2026, including
interim periods within those fiscal years, and early adoption is permitted. The Company is evaluating the applicability of this ASU to
its consolidated financial statements.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
September 2025, the FASB issued ASU 2025-06, Intangibles Goodwill and Other Internal-Use Software (Subtopic 350-40): Targeted Improvements
to the Accounting for Internal-Use Software, which includes targeted improvements to the accounting and disclosure requirements for internal-use
software costs. The amendments are effective for annual reporting periods beginning after December 15, 2027, including interim periods
within those annual reporting periods, and early adoption is permitted. The Company is currently evaluating the impact of this ASU on
its condensed consolidated financial statements.</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><p id="xdx_855_zuq3I1iksxI4" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" escape="true" id="Fact000679" name="us-gaap:SignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock"><p id="xdx_809_eus-gaap--SignificantAccountingPoliciesTextBlock_zS0TM2kaW02a" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
2: <span id="xdx_821_zrnCNfeTNTX7">Summary of Significant Accounting Policies</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">There
have been no material changes or updates to the Company&#8217;s significant accounting policies from those described in Note 1 to the
Company&#8217;s audited consolidated financial statements included in the Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30,
2025.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>Earnings
per Share</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>&#160;</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Basic
Earnings Per Share (&#8220;EPS&#8221;) is computed by dividing net income available to common shareholders by the weighted average shares
outstanding during the period. Diluted EPS takes into account the potential dilution that could occur if securities or other contracts
to issue shares, such as stock options, warrants, and unvested restricted stock units, were exercised and converted into common shares
and the impact would not be antidilutive. Diluted EPS is computed by dividing net income available to common shareholders by the weighted
average shares outstanding during the period, increased by the number of additional shares that would have been outstanding if the potential
shares had been issued and were dilutive. Contingently issuable shares are included in basic net income per share only when there is
no circumstance under which those shares would not be issued.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" escape="true" id="Fact000716" name="us-gaap:LoansNotesTradeAndOtherReceivablesDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_805_eus-gaap--LoansNotesTradeAndOtherReceivablesDisclosureTextBlock_zAeCL0vJDNug" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" escape="true" id="Fact001026" name="us-gaap:DebtDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_800_eus-gaap--DebtDisclosureTextBlock_zCfcI1BvPYCc" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
9: <span id="xdx_82E_zEnmszJH6Z5b">Revolving Credit Facility</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>New
Credit Facility</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
October 1, 2025, the Company entered into an asset-based revolving credit facility (the &#8220;New Revolving Credit Facility&#8221;)
with Bank of America, which refinanced and replaced its prior asset-based revolving credit facility with White Oak Commercial
Finance, LLC. The Revolving Credit Facility provides for borrowings of up to $<span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity_iI_pn5n6_c20251001__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__custom--WhiteOakCommercialFinanceLLCLineOfCreditMember_zvYozRdwcDu" title="Maximum borrowing capacity"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" contextRef="AsOf2025-10-01_custom_WhiteOakCommercialFinanceLLCLineOfCreditMember" id="Fact001028" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">120.0</ix:nonFraction> </span>million,
subject to a borrowing base, and matures on <span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityExpirationDate1_c20251001__20251001__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__custom--WhiteOakCommercialFinanceLLCLineOfCreditMember_z9T34GvXDAF8" title="Line of credit facility, expiration date"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-10-012025-10-01_custom_WhiteOakCommercialFinanceLLCLineOfCreditMember" format="ixt:datemonthdayyearen" id="Fact001030" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityExpirationDate1">October
1, 2030</ix:nonNumeric></span>.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Borrowings
under the Revolving Credit Facility bear interest at the 30-day SOFR rate, subject to a floor of <span id="xdx_909_ecustom--DebtInstrumentFloorRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20251001__20251001__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__us-gaap--RevolvingCreditFacilityMember__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember_zh4JxBxH1iN8"><ix:nonFraction name="AENT:DebtInstrumentFloorRate" contextRef="From2025-10-012025-10-01_us-gaap_RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_custom_WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember" id="Fact001031" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">2.00</ix:nonFraction></span>%, plus an applicable margin of
<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1_pid_dp_uPure_c20251001__20251001__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__us-gaap--RevolvingCreditFacilityMember__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember_zWDB3ML46qY6" title="Debt instrument, basis spread on variable rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" contextRef="From2025-10-012025-10-01_srt_MinimumMember_us-gaap_RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_custom_WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember" id="Fact001033" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">1.50</ix:nonFraction></span>% through March 31, 2026 and <span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1_pid_dp_uPure_c20251001__20251001__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__us-gaap--RevolvingCreditFacilityMember__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember_zMOnvYI4QRs5" title="Debt instrument, basis spread on variable rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentBasisSpreadOnVariableRate1" contextRef="From2025-10-012025-10-01_srt_MaximumMember_us-gaap_RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_custom_WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember" id="Fact001035" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">1.625</ix:nonFraction></span>% thereafter. The 30-day SOFR rate as of March 31, 2026 was <span id="xdx_90B_eus-gaap--LongTermDebtPercentageBearingVariableInterestRate_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20260331__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__us-gaap--RevolvingCreditFacilityMember__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember_zWMbU1cRTMmh" title="Long-term debt, percentage bearing variable interest, percentage rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LongTermDebtPercentageBearingVariableInterestRate" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_us-gaap_RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_custom_WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember" id="Fact001037" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">3.7</ix:nonFraction></span>%. The Company also pays a commitment
fee of <span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityUnusedCapacityCommitmentFeePercentage_pid_dp_uPure_c20250701__20260331__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__us-gaap--RevolvingCreditFacilityMember__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember_zIyoCuepVYZ" title="Line of credit facility, unused capacity, commitment fee percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityUnusedCapacityCommitmentFeePercentage" contextRef="From2025-07-012026-03-31_us-gaap_RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_custom_WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember" id="Fact001039" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">0.15</ix:nonFraction></span>% per annum on unused availability. Commitment fees incurred during the three and nine months ended March 31, 2026 and March
31, 2025 were $<span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeAmount_pn4n6_c20260101__20260331_zbooMWQD30qi" title="Commitment fees"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeAmount" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31" id="Fact001041" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-4" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.01</ix:nonFraction></span> million and $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeAmount_pn4n6_c20250701__20260331_znKXONIP881e" title="Commitment fees"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeAmount" contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" id="Fact001043" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-4" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.07</ix:nonFraction></span> million, respectively and $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeAmount_pn4n6_c20250101__20250331_z1v04gX5sV46" title="Commitment fees"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeAmount" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-03-31" id="Fact001045" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-4" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.09</ix:nonFraction></span> million and $<span id="xdx_90D_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeAmount_pn4n6_c20240701__20250331_zV3CBrLeNni8" title="Commitment fees"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeAmount" contextRef="From2024-07-012025-03-31" id="Fact001047" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-4" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.16</ix:nonFraction></span> million respectively. Included in interest expense
for the three and nine months ended March 31, 2026, is $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeAmount_pn5n6_c20260101__20260331__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__us-gaap--RevolvingCreditFacilityMember__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember_z6x0ZKiTLwx2"><span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeAmount_pn5n6_c20250701__20260331__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__us-gaap--RevolvingCreditFacilityMember__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember_zzLSt5fBRVk4"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeAmount" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_us-gaap_RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_custom_WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember" id="Fact001048" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityCommitmentFeeAmount" contextRef="From2025-07-012026-03-31_us-gaap_RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_custom_WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember" id="Fact001049" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1.6</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></span></span> million related to the accelerated amortization of unamortized deferred financing

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Availability
under the Revolving Credit Facility is based on eligible accounts receivable and inventory. As of March 31, 2026, availability was
approximately $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--LineOfCredit_iI_pn5n6_c20260331__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__us-gaap--RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_zcqZAGFeuTog" title="Availability amount"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LineOfCredit" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_us-gaap_RevolvingCreditFacilityMember" id="Fact001051" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">55.1</ix:nonFraction> million</span>,
with outstanding borrowings of approximately $<span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity_iI_pn5n6_c20260331__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__us-gaap--RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_zl8jcEJlPjRl" title="Maximum borrowing capacity"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityMaximumBorrowingCapacity" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_us-gaap_RevolvingCreditFacilityMember" id="Fact001053" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">64.9</ix:nonFraction></span>
million.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Revolving Credit Facility contains customary affirmative and negative covenants, including limitations on additional indebtedness, liens,
dividends, and certain investments, and requires the maintenance of a fixed charge coverage ratio of at least <span id="xdx_906_ecustom--FixedChargeCoverageRatio_pid_uPure_c20250701__20260331__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__us-gaap--RevolvingCreditFacilityMember__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zvJau9TG3Wqg" title="Fixed charge coverage ratio"><ix:nonFraction name="AENT:FixedChargeCoverageRatio" contextRef="From2025-07-012026-03-31_us-gaap_RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_custom_WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001055" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Pure">1.0</ix:nonFraction></span> to <span id="xdx_90F_ecustom--FixedChargeCoverageRatio_pid_uPure_c20250701__20260331__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__us-gaap--RevolvingCreditFacilityMember__us-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityAxis__custom--WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_zjDSm6b9T6d6" title="Fixed charge coverage ratio"><ix:nonFraction name="AENT:FixedChargeCoverageRatio" contextRef="From2025-07-012026-03-31_us-gaap_RevolvingCreditFacilityMember_custom_WhiteOakCommercialFinancingLlcMember_srt_MinimumMember" id="Fact001057" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Pure">1.0</ix:nonFraction></span> on a trailing
twelve-month basis, as defined in the credit agreement. The facility is secured by a first-priority security interest in substantially
all of the Company&#8217;s and its subsidiaries&#8217; assets.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company was in compliance with all applicable covenants under the Revolving Credit Facility as of March 31, 2026.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Revolving Credit Facility permits the issuance of letters of credit, which reduces availability under the borrowing base. As of March
31, 2026, the Company had letters of credit outstanding totaling $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--LinesOfCreditCurrent_iI_pn4n6_c20260331__us-gaap--CreditFacilityAxis__us-gaap--LetterOfCreditMember_zu4bHlPpxT6c" title="Outstanding letters of credit"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LinesOfCreditCurrent" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_us-gaap_LetterOfCreditMember" id="Fact001059" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-4" scale="6" unitRef="USD">0.75</ix:nonFraction></span> million.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Prior
Credit Facility</b></span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" escape="true" id="Fact001100" name="us-gaap:PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitsDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_801_eus-gaap--PensionAndOtherPostretirementBenefitsDisclosureTextBlock_zhRv8WtZCpjf" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
10: <span id="xdx_827_zO1gFpK0BxC">Employee Benefits Company Health Plans</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">During
the year ended June 30, 2025, the Company transitioned its health insurance coverage from a self-funded model to an Individual Coverage
Health Reimbursement Arrangement (&#8220;ICHRA&#8221;), which eliminates the Company&#8217;s exposure to self-insured medical and dental
claims; therefore, no similar liabilities are expected under the current plan structure. As a result, the self-insured medical plans
(including both PPO and HDHP options) under the Alliance Health &amp; Benefits Plan (&#8220;AHBP&#8221;) were terminated. Under the ICHRA
model, the Company reimburses employees and executive officers for individual health insurance premiums, with contribution levels varying
based on coverage tiers.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">There
were no changes to the Company&#8217;s dental (PPO and HMO), vision, life insurance, or short-term disability plans. The Company&#8217;s
dental HMO plan remains self-insured, with exposure limited to a maximum per individual procedure based on a published fee schedule.
The dental PPO plan is fully insured. The Company contributes various percentages toward premium costs across benefit offerings, based
on coverage levels and Board-approved schedules. The vision, life insurance, and short- and long-term disability plans are fully insured
and Company-sponsored, with premiums paid by both the employer and employees in accordance with Board-approved contribution structures.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
of March 31, 2026, and June 30, 2025, the Company had no remaining liability related to the terminated self-insured medical plans, as
the previously accrued estimated run-out exposure was fully settled during the first quarter of fiscal 2026.</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" escape="true" id="Fact001116" name="us-gaap:SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_80F_eus-gaap--SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock_zrEuxIMT39b4" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
11: <span id="xdx_825_zngpQ2eHJ8wd">Segment Information</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Management
performed an assessment of the Company&#8217;s operating segments in accordance with ASC 280-10-50-1 through 50-9. Based on this evaluation,
the Company determined that it operates as a single operating segment, which is also its sole reportable segment. Segment revenue is
derived from the sale of distribution of pre-recorded music, video movies, video games and related accessories, and merchandising. This
conclusion is consistent with prior periods.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company&#8217;s Chief Executive Officer and Chairman are the Chief Operating Decision Makers (&#8220;CODM&#8221;) and review financial
performance and make resource allocation decisions at the consolidated entity level. The CODM utilizes net income, prepared in accordance
with U.S. GAAP, to evaluate financial performance, monitor variances against budget and forecast, and guide strategic decisions. Segment
assets are reported as consolidated assets on the Company&#8217;s condensed consolidated balance sheet.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

expense categories regularly reviewed by the CODM include:</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" escape="true" id="Fact001151" name="us-gaap:IncomeTaxDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_800_eus-gaap--IncomeTaxDisclosureTextBlock_zknEIB4wAJU5" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
12: <span id="xdx_82A_zMdINfWoC6Ge">Income Taxes</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
effective tax rates were <span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationOtherAdjustments_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331_z5d4nHKJEZid"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationOtherAdjustments" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31" id="Fact001152" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">12</ix:nonFraction></span>%
and </span><span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationOtherAdjustments_pid_dp_uPure_c20250101__20250331_z7h0lClZ3DCj" style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationOtherAdjustments" contextRef="From2025-01-012025-03-31" id="Fact001153" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">33</ix:nonFraction></span><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">%
for the three months ended March 31, 2026 and 2025, respectively. In accordance with ASC 740-270, the Company calculates its interim
income tax provision using an estimated annual effective tax rate (&#8220;ETR&#8221;) applied to year-to-date ordinary income. This approach
ensures that the interim tax expense reflects the best estimate of the annual tax rate, as required by U.S. GAAP. Items that are unusual,
infrequent, or not expected to recur such as discrete events are recognized separately in the period in which they occur and are not
included in the estimated annual ETR. The difference between the Company&#8217;s effective tax rate for the three months ended March
31, 2026, and the federal statutory rate primarily resulted from state income taxes, Foreign Derived Intangible Income, and fair value
adjustments related to the Company&#8217;s warrant liability.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
effective tax rate was approximately <span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationOtherAdjustments_pid_dp_uPure_c20250701__20260331_zhL4wKumVsJf" title="Effective tax rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationOtherAdjustments" contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" id="Fact001155" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">26</ix:nonFraction></span>% and <span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationOtherAdjustments_pid_dp_uPure_c20240701__20250331_zw8ka2e3Cec" title="Effective tax rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationOtherAdjustments" contextRef="From2024-07-012025-03-31" id="Fact001157" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">19</ix:nonFraction></span>% for the nine months ended March 31, 2026, and 2025, respectively. The difference between
the Company&#8217;s effective tax rate and the U.S. federal statutory rate for the nine months ended March 31, 2026, primarily resulted
from state income taxes, FDII, fair value adjustments related to the Company&#8217;s warrant liability, and tax items attributable to
periods prior to the Company&#8217;s acquisition by its parent. The difference between the Company&#8217;s effective tax rate and the
U.S. federal statutory rate for the nine months ended March 31, 2025, primarily resulted from state income taxes, FDII, and a discrete
item related to an out-of-measurement period adjustment to the deferred tax liability related to software costs.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company completed the acquisition of Endstate Authentic LLC on December 31, 2025. For U.S. federal and state income tax purposes, the
transaction is treated as a taxable purchase of assets because Endstate Authentic LLC is a disregarded entity. As a result, the tax basis
of the acquired assets and assumed liabilities was stepped up generally to their respective fair values. Based on the Company&#8217;s
analysis as of the acquisition date, the acquisition did not result in material acquisition-date temporary differences and, accordingly,
no material deferred tax assets or liabilities were recorded in connection with the acquisition.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" escape="true" id="Fact001159" name="us-gaap:CommitmentsAndContingenciesDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_80D_eus-gaap--CommitmentsAndContingenciesDisclosureTextBlock_zkirssR7KXT8" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
13: <span id="xdx_824_z8jfP34vgZxe">Commitments and Contingencies</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Commitments</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><i>&#160;</i></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company enters into various agreements with suppliers for the products it distributes. The Company had <span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--LongTermPurchaseCommitmentAmount_do_c20250701__20260331_zX9ZqoDE5at6" title="Amount of long-term purchase commitments or arrangements"><span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--LongTermPurchaseCommitmentAmount_do_c20240701__20250630_zwRcHpAc3IOg" title="Amount of long-term purchase commitments or arrangements"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LongTermPurchaseCommitmentAmount" contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" id="Fact001161" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="0" unitRef="USD"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LongTermPurchaseCommitmentAmount" contextRef="From2024-07-012025-06-30" id="Fact001163" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">no</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></span></span> long-term purchase commitments
or arrangements with its suppliers as of March 31, 2026, and June 30, 2025.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Litigation,
Claims and Assessments</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">We
are exposed to claims and litigations of varying degrees arising in the ordinary course of business and use various methods to resolve
these matters. When a loss is probable, we record an accrual based on the reasonably estimable loss or range of loss. When no point of
loss is more likely than another, we record the lowest amount in the estimated range of loss and, if material, disclose the estimated
range of loss. We do not record liabilities for reasonably possible loss contingencies but do disclose a range of reasonably possible
losses if they are material and we are able to estimate such a range. If we cannot provide a range of reasonably possible losses, we
explain the factors that prevent us from determining such a range. Historically, adjustments to our estimates have not been material.
We believe the recorded reserves in our condensed consolidated financial statements are adequate in light of the probable and estimable
liabilities. We do not believe that any of these identified claims or litigation will be material to our results of operations, cash
flows, or financial condition.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Video
Privacy Protection Act Matters. </b>Beginning in August 2024, several putative class actions and related proceedings were filed against
the Company and its subsidiary, DirectToU, LLC (&#8220;DirectToU&#8221;), in federal courts and arbitration alleging violations of the
Video Privacy Protection Act (&#8220;VPPA&#8221;) and similar state laws. The complaints generally allege that the Company disclosed
certain customer information and video viewing or purchasing data to third parties through the use of website tracking technologies.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
June 2025, the parties reached a settlement resolving the VPPA-related claims, subject to court approval. The settlement provides
for a cash payment of $<span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--PaymentsForLegalSettlements_pn3n6_c20250601__20250630_zqvakrrZCtD1" title="Settlement liability"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PaymentsForLegalSettlements" contextRef="From2025-06-012025-06-30" id="Fact001165" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1.577</ix:nonFraction></span>
million to the class. The Company expects a portion of the settlement payment to be covered by insurance and, accordingly, recorded
an insurance receivable of $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--InsuredEventGainLoss_pn3n6_c20250601__20250630_zqdZL5BNtuOl" title="Insurance recovery"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:InsuredEventGainLoss" contextRef="From2025-06-012025-06-30" id="Fact001167" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1.377</ix:nonFraction></span>
million. The Company recorded a settlement liability of $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--PaymentsForLegalSettlements_pn3n6_c20260101__20260331_zXPDB3M25twk" title="Settlement liability"><span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--PaymentsForLegalSettlements_pn3n6_c20250701__20260331_zuZ4QwK2x7r7" title="Settlement liability"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PaymentsForLegalSettlements" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31" id="Fact001169" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="6" unitRef="USD"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PaymentsForLegalSettlements" contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" id="Fact001171" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-3" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1.577</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></span></span>
million and the related insurance receivable during the three and nine months ended March 31, 2026, and such amounts remained
recorded in accrued expenses on the Company&#8217;s condensed consolidated financial statements as of March 31, 2026.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
court granted preliminary approval of the settlement in October 2025. Final approval of the settlement remains pending. The Company believes
the recorded accrual is adequate based on currently available information.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Office

a civil action against COKeM International Ltd. (&#8220;COKeM&#8221;) in the United States District Court for the District of Minnesota,
alleging contributory trademark infringement, false designation of origin, unfair competition, unjust enrichment, and civil conspiracy

No damages
have been awarded.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">COKeM has denied the allegations and filed a third-party complaint against

agreement, which is reflected in Office Create&#8217;s expert damages analysis.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Discovery is ongoing. On March 9, 2026, Office Create served an expert report
opining that total damages are approximately $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--LossContingencyDamagesSoughtValue_pn4n6_c20260309__20260309_zzH9TZSPK4eb" title="Damages"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LossContingencyDamagesSoughtValue" contextRef="From2026-03-092026-03-09" id="Fact001175" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-4" scale="6" unitRef="USD">37.9</ix:nonFraction></span> million. Trial readiness is scheduled for October 2026. The Company maintains insurance
coverage that may apply, subject to policy limits. The Company cannot reasonably estimate a possible loss, and no accrual has been recorded.</p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Sparkle
Pop Matter. </b>On June 9, 2025, Sparkle Pop, LLC filed an adversary proceeding against the Company in the United States Bankruptcy Court
for the District of Maryland in the matter <i>In re Diamond Comic Distributors</i>, alleging theft of trade secrets and tortious interference
with contractual relations. The Company has moved to dismiss the amended complaint, and that motion remains pending. The Company denies
the allegations. At this time, the Company cannot reasonably estimate the amount or range of any potential loss associated with this
matter, and no accrual has been recorded.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

Demand. </b>In November 2025, the Company received a demand letter asserting potential claims under the federal Telephone Consumer Protection
Act against its subsidiary, DirectToU, LLC, relating to alleged marketing text messages. No complaint has been filed, and discussions
between the parties are ongoing. At this time, the Company cannot reasonably estimate the amount or range of any potential loss associated
with this matter, and no accrual has been recorded.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">From
time to time, the Company is involved in other legal and regulatory matters arising in the ordinary course of business.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
December 2024, DirectToU, LLC received a third-party tender of defense regarding a notice of alleged noncompliance with California Proposition
65 concerning a product supplied by a vendor and sold by the Company. The Company discontinued the product and tendered defense to the
supplier, which has assumed responsibility for responding to the notice. The Company does not believe this matter is material.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
July 2025, the Company received a cease-and-desist letter alleging a breach of a contractual non-solicitation provision. The Company
disputes the allegations, has responded to the correspondence, and has not filed any litigation. The Company does not believe this matter
is material.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Tariffs
and Trade Policy: IEEPA Ruling and Contingent Refund</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Background.
</b>From February 4, 2025, through February 24, 2026, the U.S. government imposed tariffs on imported goods pursuant to executive orders
issued under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA). These tariffs affected certain products the Company imported during
that period.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Supreme
Court Ruling. </b>On February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court issued a 6-3 decision in <i>Learning Resources, Inc. v. Trump</i>, No.
24-1287, holding that IEEPA does not authorize the President to impose tariffs. The ruling invalidated all IEEPA-based tariffs imposed
during the period February 4, 2025, through February 24, 2026. Following the ruling, President Trump issued an executive order terminating
the IEEPA tariff orders, effective February 24, 2026. The ruling did not affect tariffs imposed under other statutory authorities, including
Section 232 (steel and aluminium) and Section 301 (goods of Chinese origin), which remain in effect.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>CIT
Refund Order. </b>On March 4, 2026, the U.S. Court of International Trade (CIT) issued an order directing U.S. Customs and Border Protection
(CBP) to refund IEEPA duties to importers of record through CBP&#8217;s normal administrative procedures. On March 6, 2026, the CIT suspended
enforcement of that order to allow CBP time to develop a dedicated refund processing system. The CIT&#8217;s directive to provide refunds
remains in place; only enforcement has been temporarily suspended. CBP has launched the Consolidated Administration
and Processing of Entries (CAPE) portal on April 20, 2026, to process refund applications. The government&#8217;s deadline to appeal
the scope of the CIT&#8217;s refund order is approximately June 7, 2026.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Contingent
Refund. </b>The Company is the importer of record on entries subject to IEEPA tariffs paid during the period February 4, 2025, through
February 24, 2026. Based on the Company&#8217;s internal analysis of its CBP entry records, management estimates the total IEEPA tariffs
paid for which a refund may be available to be approximately $<span id="xdx_90C_ecustom--InternationalEmergencyEconomicPowersActTariffs_pn5n6_c20250204__20260224_zBCvVv3Jtej3" title="IEEPA tariffs"><ix:nonFraction name="AENT:InternationalEmergencyEconomicPowersActTariffs" contextRef="From2025-02-042026-02-24" id="Fact001177" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">1.5</ix:nonFraction></span> million. The Company has not recognized a receivable for this amount
in its condensed consolidated balance sheet as of March 31, 2026, as the refund process remains subject to administrative implementation
by CBP, potential government appeal of the CIT&#8217;s refund order, and other procedural uncertainties. The amount and timing of any
refund the Company ultimately receives may differ materially from management&#8217;s estimate. The Company intends to submit its refund
application through the CAPE portal and will continue to monitor developments.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>No
Impact to Current Period Results. </b>The impact of IEEPA tariffs on the Company&#8217;s cost of sales during the quarter ended March
31, 2026 and the year-to-date period was not material.</span></p>

31, 2026 and June 30, 2025.</span></p>
<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" escape="true" id="Fact001228" name="us-gaap:OperatingLeasesOfLessorDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_803_eus-gaap--OperatingLeasesOfLessorDisclosureTextBlock_zJujhYq3JkM9" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
15: <span id="xdx_820_zeF7j0MjOEy4">Leases</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company leases offices, warehouses, computer equipment, and vehicles. Certain leases include options to renew, which may extend the lease
term from <span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--LesseeOperatingLeaseRenewalTerm_iI_dtY_c20260331__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_zEl6olrXttsk"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_srt_MinimumMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="Fact001229" name="us-gaap:LesseeOperatingLeaseRenewalTerm">1</ix:nonNumeric></span> to <span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--LesseeOperatingLeaseRenewalTerm_iI_dtY_c20260331__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zy62rgleVk6l" title="Extend lease term"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_srt_MaximumMember" format="ixt-sec:duryear" id="Fact001231" name="us-gaap:LesseeOperatingLeaseRenewalTerm">13</ix:nonNumeric></span> years. The decision to exercise renewal options is at the Company&#8217;s sole discretion and is included in the lease
term when it is reasonably certain that the option will be exercised.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Leasehold
improvements and assets are depreciated over the shorter of their useful life or the lease term unless the lease includes a purchase
option or title transfer that is reasonably certain to occur.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Our
lease agreements do not include material residual value guarantees or restrictive covenants. Lease payments generally include fixed payments,
with some leases requiring variable payments. These variable payments typically cover the Company&#8217;s proportionate share of property
taxes, insurance, and common area maintenance and are recognized as incurred rather than being included in the lease liability.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
the condensed consolidated balance sheet, operating leases are reflected in &#8220;Operating Lease Right-of-Use Assets, Net,&#8221; &#8220;Current
Portion of Operating Lease Obligations,&#8221; and &#8220;Operating Lease Obligations, Non-Current.&#8221; Finance leases are included
under &#8220;Property &amp; Equipment, Net,&#8221; &#8220;Current Portion of Finance Lease Obligations,&#8221; and &#8220;Finance Lease
Obligations, Non-Current.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
extended lease term will result in continued amortization of the ROU asset over the remaining lease period, with the associated lease
liabilities being remeasured in accordance with ASC 842, <i>Leases</i>. The Company will continue to amortize the ROU asset in line with
the revised lease terms and conditions, reflecting the financial impact of the extension in future periods.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-07-01to2026-03-31" escape="true" id="Fact001362" name="us-gaap:MergersAcquisitionsAndDispositionsDisclosuresTextBlock"><p id="xdx_805_eus-gaap--MergersAcquisitionsAndDispositionsDisclosuresTextBlock_zgkYquVt68X9" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
16: <span id="xdx_821_zWPipEQahee6">Merger</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
disclosed in Note 1, on February 10, 2023, the Company completed the Merger with Alliance and a Merger Sub, resulting in the Company
becoming a publicly traded company. While Adara was the legal acquirer in the Merger, for financial accounting and reporting purposes
under U.S. GAAP, Legacy Alliance was the accounting acquirer, and the Merger was accounted for as a &#8220;reverse recapitalization.&#8221;
A reverse recapitalization (i.e., a capital transaction involving the exchange of stock by Alliance for Legacy Alliance&#8217;s stock)
does not result in a new basis of accounting, and the consolidated financial statements of the combined entity represent the continuation
of the consolidated financial statements of Legacy Alliance. Accordingly, the consolidated assets, liabilities, and results of operations
of Legacy Alliance became the historical consolidated financial statements of the combined company, and Alliance&#8217;s assets, liabilities
and results of operations were consolidated with Legacy Alliance beginning on the acquisition date. Operations prior to the Merger are
presented as those of Legacy Alliance in future reports. The net assets of Alliance were recognized at historical cost (which was consistent
with carrying value), with no goodwill or other intangible assets recorded.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.25in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">At
the closing of the Merger, each of the then issued and outstanding shares of Alliance common stock were cancelled and automatically converted
into the right to receive the number of shares of Alliance common stock equal to the exchange ratio (determined in accordance with the
Business Combination Agreement). The Company&#8217;s <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesOutstanding_iI_pid_c20260331__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--AdaraAcquisitionCorpMember_zLCl42DNfLZ2" title="Common stock, shares outstanding"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_custom_AdaraAcquisitionCorpMember" id="Fact001364" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">900</ix:nonFraction></span> shares of previously outstanding common stock were exchanged for <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--CommonStockSharesOutstanding_iI_pid_c20260331__us-gaap--BusinessAcquisitionAxis__custom--AdaraAcquisitionCorpMember__us-gaap--StatementClassOfStockAxis__us-gaap--CommonClassAMember_zLkMU95xOLDf" title="Common stock, shares outstanding"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_custom_AdaraAcquisitionCorpMember_us-gaap_CommonClassAMember" id="Fact001366" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">47,500,000</ix:nonFraction></span>
shares of Class A Common Stock. In addition, the treasury stock was cancelled. This change in equity structure has been retroactively
reflected in the financial statements for all periods presented.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>
